result.summary: The page is generally polished, but a few horizontal overflow and viewport-obscuring issues make the layout look slightly broken.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped at the right edge: the Healthy chip is followed by a partially visible next chip with no clear scroll affordance or right padding.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the horizontal carousel to the viewport, add end padding, and ensure the partial next item is intentionally indicated or fully hidden.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel cuts off the third restaurant card and its title at the right edge, making the content appear accidentally truncated.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearly scrollable carousel with consistent card spacing and a deliberate peek amount, or fit the cards within the available width.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the second restaurant card, leaving its image abruptly cut off and hiding the card’s title and details.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content padding or adjust the scroll position so restaurant content is not obscured by the navigation bar.
